title: Online Imitation Learning for Manipulation via Decaying Relative Correction through Teleoperation
title_zh: 通过遥操作进行衰减相对修正的在线模仿学习用于操作任务
abstract: Teleoperated robotic manipulators enable the collection of demonstration data, which can be used to train control policies through imitation learning. However, such methods can require significant amounts of training data to develop robust policies or adapt them to new and unseen tasks. While expert feedback can significantly enhance policy performance, providing continuous feedback can be cognitively demanding and time-consuming for experts. To address this challenge, we propose using a cable-driven teleoperation system that can provide spatial corrections with 6 degrees of freedom to the trajectories generated by a policy model. Specifically, we propose a correction method termed Decaying Relative Correction (DRC), which is based upon the spatial offset vector provided by the expert and exists temporarily, reducing the number of intervention steps required by an expert. Our results demonstrate that DRC reduces the required expert intervention rate by 30% compared to a standard absolute corrective method. Furthermore, we show that integrating DRC within an online imitation learning framework rapidly increases the success rate of manipulation tasks such as raspberry harvesting and cloth wiping.
abstract_zh: 遥操作机械臂能够收集演示数据，这些数据可用于通过模仿学习训练控制策略。然而，这类方法可能需要大量训练数据才能开发出鲁棒策略或适应新的未见任务。虽然专家反馈可以显著提升策略性能，但持续提供反馈对专家来说认知负担重且耗时。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出使用一种缆驱动遥操作系统，该系统能够对策略模型生成的轨迹提供6自由度的空间修正。具体来说，我们提出一种称为衰减相对修正（DRC）的修正方法，该方法基于专家提供的空间偏移向量，并且该偏移临时存在，从而减少专家所需的干预步骤数。我们的结果表明，与标准的绝对修正方法相比，DRC将所需的专家干预率降低了30%。此外，我们表明，将DRC集成到在线模仿学习框架中，可以快速提高树莓采摘和擦布等操作任务的成功率。
tldr_zh: 提出衰减相对修正方法，减少专家干预并提升在线模仿学习效率。
cover_zh: 专家干预减少30%！这个遥操作修正方法让机器人学得更快
